baecontemplate

Overview

baecontemplate is the pkgdown template for baeconverse packages.

In R package, add the following in DESCRIPTION:

Config/Needs/website: baeconverse/baecontemplate

In _pkgdown.yml:

template:
  package: baecontemplate
  bootstrap: 5
